# Will the platform report you to the tax authority?

> Free DAC7 checker for online sellers and hosts: will the platform report your sales or rentals to the tax authority this year? Checks the 30-sales / EUR 2,000 goods exemption, headroom, what is sent and the TIN deadline. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
